issue.title: Hold a reserved book for 48 hours before releasing it
issue.body:
**Parent:** #90

### Acceptance Criteria
1. A reserved copy stays on hold for **48 hours** after the reservation.
2. If the reader does not collect it, the copy returns to the shelf.

Screenshot: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0a1b2c3d-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
See also #95.

# 101 — Hold a reserved book for 48 hours

## TL;DR

**Problem.** Holds end at once.
**Cause.** Nothing keeps them.
**Action.** Keep them 48 hours.
**Result.** Readers collect their books.

## 3.1 Functional requirements

- **REQ-1** When a copy is reserved, the system shall hold it for 48 hours.

<!-- besman:spec-document -->
@claude REQ-1 should also cover e-book loans.
